narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed near the mountains, and a lee side surface trough, to the north and then shifted south and organized into a Mesoscale Convective System (MCS) that produced strong damaging winds and some hail across the Midlands of SC, along with locally heavy rain and flooding in the Columbia metropolitan area, in the afternoon and evening.
ev: The ground floor of a building at Canalside Lofts was flooded.
An apartment was flooded at 1015 Assembly St.

Heavy rain led to flooding in multiple areas. A vehicle was flooded at Gervais St and Laurens St. Water rescues were performed at Whaley St and Main St, where a vehicle was flooded, on S. Assembly St near Ferguson St, and Pickens St near Pendleton St. |Other flooded roadways included Monroe St and Maple St, and Blossom St at Barnwell St near Maxcy Gregg Park.
A vehicle was flooded at 1850 Atlantic Ave. An apartment was flooded at 2010 Watermark Pl. A building was flooded at 1216 Broad River Rd.
Flooded roadway at Gervais St and Huger St and at Huger St at Senate St.
A water rescue was performed near St. Andrews Rd and Burning Tree Dr.
USGS stream gage on the Rocky Branch Creek at Main St and Whaley St measured a peak stage of 11.32 feet at 1900 EDT (1800 EST). Flood stage is 7.3 feet.
SCHP reported flooding at Bakersfield Rd and Dutch Square Blvd.
SCHP reported flooded road at US Hwy 1 near I-20.
